verdict.rationale: Serving LoRA adapters is a fair question for an LLM inference server like llama.cpp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions LoRA adapters, loading several of them, or switching them over a shared base model. The pack covers only general server, quantization and hardware support, which does not establish this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
